changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/11573-any-component-emit-headroom.md`

- names `packages/types/src/__tests__/any-component-emit-headroom-11573.test.ts` → `packages/types/src/__tests__/any-component-emit-headroom-11573.test.ts` — edited by this change

  > `packages/types/src/__tests__/any-component-emit-headroom-11573.test.ts` reads the declaration's size with the compiler's own counter, fails when it crosses a tenth of the ceiling below it, and lists every member as named or inline.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `fc211e817` (merge-base with origin/main): 9 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 443 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (459 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/38615432586)

### ① Derived judgments

- **Checks.** All 33 check-runs on `83d91d3` are `completed`; every one is `success` except the three `skipped` (dependabot, `Test (coverage)`, the coverage shard matrix). That includes `Test` and all 12 shards, `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Repo Gates`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, the four changeset gates, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and `Line Citation Gate`. No gate is red on this head; the dev's local `check:spec-floors` exit 1 is the known `main` failure (objectui#12334) and `Repo Gates` is green regardless.
- **Arms: `RecordApprovalsBlockSchema` and `RecordAttachmentsBlockSchema` = `BaseSchema` + `type` literal + optional `properties: z.strictObject({})` + `body` / `children` tombstoned; two new `AnyComponentSchema` members.** Right, and the derivation from the spec rows is sound. On the installed spec, `ComponentPropsMap['record:attachments']` is `emptyProps('record:attachments')` built inline and exported under no name; `ComponentPropsMap['record:approvals']` is the module-private `const RecordApprovalsProps`, a `strictObject` with no member (its `guidance` map carries per-key prescriptions for `approvals` and `currentUserId`, which are refusal messages, not declared keys). Neither can cross the objectui#8317 boundary by reference, so a restated empty strict bag is the only faithful form, the same construction #12342 landed and the card asked for. The accept set of each bag is `{}` alone, identical to its row. `record-panels-arms-12363.test.ts` reads the INSTALLED rows on every run and pins each arm's key set and accept set to them (five probe bags including both host keys, plus a control that the row itself refuses a key), so a prop the spec adds later turns the file red. Derivation with a gate: right.
- **Not in `public-blocks.zod.ts`.** Right: that union is pinned to the ADR-0080 curated list, neither block is curated, and #12342 set the precedent of a module of its own.
- **Refused by name: `body` / `children` via `retirementTombstone`.** Right. The spec reads neither panel as a container, and the arm's text matches the #12342 arm's shape line for line, with the renderer facts changed (`RecordApprovalsRenderer` also reads the host payload off the node; `RecordAttachmentsRenderer` reads `className` and designer attributes only).
- **Published surface, measured on the faces.** `@object-ui/types` `.` entry gains two type exports (`RecordApprovalsBlockSchema`, `RecordAttachmentsBlockSchema`, from the new `record-panels.ts`) and `AnySchema` gains both members; `./zod` gains two value exports of the same names (from the new `record-panels.zod.ts`), and `AnyComponentSchema` / `StrictAnyComponentSchema` / `safeValidateSchema` accept two more `type` literals. Nothing is removed or narrowed. No `package.json` `exports` field moves (the bundle report shows `types (record-panels.js)` as a new per-module chunk, which is the existing build glob). `@object-ui/cli` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` publish nothing new: each changes only under `__tests__/`. The dev's Clause-② table is right on every face.
- **Ratchet: `NAMESPACED_REFUSED_AT_TYPE` 308 to 306.** Right. `main` at the merge-base reads 308; the pin falls by exactly the two keys armed; the new row pins `refusedAtType(key) === false` for both, `BARE_KEYS` without the bare twins (both registered `skipFallback: true`), and a lit control that an unclaimed `record:` literal is still refused. The #12342 row's stale comment about unarmed siblings is corrected.
- **Mirror parity and emit headroom.** `EXPECTED_MIRROR_PAIRS` 196 to 198 with both pairs declared in `MIRRORS` and `Declared`; two `inline` arm rows in the emit-headroom ledger. Consistent with the diff; the 11573 changeset's claim that the test "lists every member as named or inline" stays true with the two rows added.
- **Default record page validates whole.** Right, and non-vacuous: `buildDefaultPageSchema.validatesWhole-12363.test.ts` first asserts both panel types are present in the page, then passes it on both faces, and passes the Attachments-only page. The pin lives in `packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/` because `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/cli` do not depend on `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and the reverse import is what `check:phantom-deps` refuses; no plugin-detail source changes.
- **The A2 boundary: a page with the host's `approvals.node` payload is refused at the `record:approvals` bag.** Right to pin it as a refusal and not widen the arm. `buildDefaultPageSchema` spreads `approvals.node` verbatim into the node (line 931), and `RecordDetailView` threads `approvals` + `currentUserId` through it; the spec row names both the HOST's runtime channel ("not authorable surface") and refuses them. No runtime path hands that synthesized page to `safeValidateSchema` / `StrictAnyComponentSchema` (none in `RecordDetailView.tsx` or `plugin-detail/src` outside tests), and before this PR the same page was refused at `type` anyway, so nothing regresses. The pin asserts exactly one issue, `unrecognized_keys` at `children.0.properties`, keys `[approvals, currentUserId]`, and the `record:history` `entries` / `loading` class is the stated precedent.

### ② Semver level

- `types` minor: right. Two new exports on each of two published faces and a wider accept set on `AnyComponentSchema` / `StrictAnyComponentSchema` / `safeValidateSchema`; nothing removed. Under objectui AGENTS.md §9 nothing here could be `major`, and `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check` and `Changeset Overwrite Report` are green on the head.
- `cli` and `plugin-detail` not declared: right. One typo that does not change meaning: "the default record page `buildDefaultPageSchema` builds emits both" (a stray "builds"). Prose only; the seat may fix it before the queue, no frontmatter change.
